prompt_scan:
You are a precise fashion item parser. Analyze the image and identify ALL distinct clothing items currently WORN by the PRIMARY person in the foreground.
CRITICAL RULES:
- IGNORE any clothing items in the background (e.g., clothes on beds, chairs, hangers).
- Focus ONLY on the main subject's outfit.
- If the image shows a single item with no person (laid flat, on a hanger), describe that item.
Respond ONLY with a raw JSON array of objects — no markdown, no code fences.
Each object must have EXACTLY these keys:
- "name": string (Short descriptive name in Italian, e.g. "Giacca in pelle", "Jeans slim")
- "category": string (ONE OF: "Upper Body", "Lower Body", "Full Body", "Shoes", "Outerwear", "Accessory", "Essentials")
- "subCategory": string (ONE OF based on category):
  Upper Body → "T-Shirt", "Shirt", "Polo", "Hoodie" (felpa con cappuccio), "Sweatshirt" (felpa senza cappuccio), "Sweater", "Tank Top", "Crop Top", "Thermal Top" (maglia termica, strato base), "Fleece" (pile), "Other"
  Lower Body → "Jeans", "Shorts", "Trousers", "Leggings", "Skirt", "Sweatpants" (pantaloni della tuta; in italiano 'tuta' e' sempre questo), "Swimwear" (costume da bagno, bikini), "Thermal Bottoms" (calzamaglia o pantaloni termici), "Ski Pants" (pantaloni da sci o salopette), "Wetsuit" (muta da sub o da surf), "Other"
  Full Body → "Dress" (vestito o abito da donna, copre sopra e sotto), "Other"
  Shoes → "Sneakers", "Sandals", "Boots", "Flip-Flops", "Loafers", "Dress Shoes", "Hiking Boots", "Water Shoes" (scarpe da acqua o da scoglio), "Snow Boots" (doposci o scarponi da neve), "Other"
  Outerwear → "Coat", "Rain Jacket" (giacca antipioggia, guscio impermeabile), "Down Jacket" (piumino), "Windbreaker" (giacca a vento, k-way, softshell), "Blazer", "Ski Jacket" (giacca da sci), "Ski Suit" (tuta da sci intera, copre anche le gambe), "Casual Jacket" (giacca casual: di jeans, bomber, giacca camicia), "Vest" (gilet o smanicato), "Other"
  Accessory → "Cap/Hat" (cappello, berretto, cuffia di lana), "Belt", "Bag", "Scarf", "Sunglasses", "Jewelry", "Watch", "Gloves" (guanti), "Tie" (cravatta o papillon), "Umbrella" (ombrello), "Other"
  Essentials → "Underwear" (mutande, boxer, reggiseno, canottiera intima), "Socks" (calze e calzini), "Pajamas" (pigiama), "Other"
- "baseColor": string (Primary color in Italian, e.g. "Nero", "Bianco", "Blu navy")
- "pattern": string (ONE OF: "Solid", "Striped", "Plaid", "Graphic", "Logo", "Floral", "Other")
- "coverage": string (ONE OF: "Short-sleeve", "Long-sleeve", "Sleeveless", "Shorts", "Full-length", "Cropped", "N/A"; tops, dresses and jackets use the sleeve length, a coat is "Long-sleeve"; "Shorts", "Full-length", "Cropped" only for trousers, shorts and skirts; shoes, accessories and essentials "N/A")
- "fit": string (ONE OF: "Skinny", "Regular", "Oversize", "N/A")
- "warmth": integer (1 to 5: 1=canottiera/sandali, 2=t-shirt/sneakers, 3=felpa/jeans, 4=cappotto/stivali, 5=piumino/scarponi)
- "formality": string (ONE OF: "Loungewear", "Casual", "Smart Casual", "Business", "Formal")
- "activityTags": array of 1-3 strings (ONLY from: ["Everyday", "Office", "Beach", "Swimming", "Hiking", "Sport", "Formal", "Lounge"])
- "waterResistance": integer (0 = gets wet in the rain, 1 = resists light rain, 2 = waterproof)
- "bulk": integer (1 = folds small like a t-shirt, 2 = medium like jeans or sneakers, 3 = bulky like a coat or boots)

subCategory.instructions: What kind of item is this?

criteria.Thermal Top: Upper Body: Thermal Top (maglia termica, strato base)
criteria.Sweatpants: Lower Body: Sweatpants (pantaloni della tuta; in italiano 'tuta' e' sempre questo)
criteria.Swimwear: Lower Body: Swimwear (costume da bagno, bikini)
criteria.Thermal Bottoms: Lower Body: Thermal Bottoms (calzamaglia o pantaloni termici)
criteria.Ski Pants: Lower Body: Ski Pants (pantaloni da sci o salopette)
criteria.Wetsuit: Lower Body: Wetsuit (muta da sub o da surf)
criteria.Dress: Full Body: Dress (vestito o abito da donna, copre sopra e sotto)
criteria.Water Shoes: Shoes: Water Shoes (scarpe da acqua o da scoglio)
criteria.Snow Boots: Shoes: Snow Boots (doposci o scarponi da neve)
criteria.Rain Jacket: Outerwear: Rain Jacket (giacca antipioggia, guscio impermeabile)
criteria.Windbreaker: Outerwear: Windbreaker (giacca a vento, k-way, softshell)
criteria.Ski Suit: Outerwear: Ski Suit (tuta da sci intera, copre anche le gambe)
criteria.Casual Jacket: Outerwear: Casual Jacket (giacca casual: di jeans, bomber, giacca camicia)
criteria.Cap/Hat: Accessory: Cap/Hat (cappello, berretto, cuffia di lana)
criteria.Underwear: Essentials: Underwear (mutande, boxer, reggiseno, canottiera intima)
criteria.Not Clothing: not a clothing item: electronics, toiletries, documents, other objects

criteria.1: very light, like a tank top or sandals
criteria.2: light, like a t-shirt or sneakers
criteria.3: medium, like a sweatshirt or jeans
criteria.4: warm, like a coat or leather boots
criteria.5: very warm, like a down jacket or mountain boots
